formulas.value: Robot Age in Years (RAY): For a given robot R, let D be the instdateval from robot_details where botdetreg = R, and T be the rects from robot_record where recreg = R. Then, RAY = \frac{(T - D).days}{365.25}

Average Joint 1 Temperature (AJ1T): For a given robot R, AJ1T = \frac{\sum_{jc \in \text{joint_condition} \mid \text{jcdetref = R}} j1tempval}{|\{jc \in \text{joint_condition} \mid \text{jcdetref = R}\}|}

Maximum Joint Temperature (MJT): For a given robot R, MJT = \max_{jc \in \text{joint_condition} \mid \text{jcdetref = R}} \max(jc.j1tempval, jc.j2tempval, jc.j3tempval, jc.j4tempval, jc.j5tempval, jc.j6tempval)
Average Position Error (APE): For a given robot R, APE = \frac{\sum_{ad \in \text{actuation_data} \mid \text{actdetref = R}} poserrmmval}{|\{ad \in \text{actuation_data} \mid \text{actdetref = R}\}|}
Average TCP Speed (ATCS): For a given robot R, ATCS = \frac{\sum_{ad \in \text{actuation_data} \mid \text{actdetref = R}} tcpspeedval}{|\{ad \in \text{actuation_data} \mid \text{actdetref = R}\}|}

Recent Fault Prediction Score (RFPS): For a given robot R, \text{faultpredscore}(mf) \text{ where } mf \in \text{maintenance_and_fault}, \text{upkeeprobot} = R, \text{and } \text{upkeepduedays}(mf) = \min_{mf' \in \text{maintenance_and_fault} \mid \text{upkeeprobot} = R} \text{upkeepduedays}(mf').
Minimum Remaining Useful Life (MRUL): For a given robot R, MRUL = \min_{mf \in \text{maintenance_and_fault} \mid \text{upkeeprobot = R}} rulhours
Total Operating Hours (TOH): For a given robot R, TOH = \max_{o \in \text{operation} \mid \text{operbotdetref = R}} totopshrval
Number of Operations (NO): For a given robot R, NO = |\{o \in \text{operation} \mid \text{operbotdetref = R}\}|
Total Program Cycles (TPC): For a given robot R, TPC = \sum_{o \in \text{operation} \mid \text{operbotdetref = R}} progcyclecount
Fast Robot: The robot is fast if ATCS > 1000.
High Fault Risk: The robot has high fault risk if RFPS > 0.5.
Multi-Operation Robot: The robot has performed multiple operations if NO > 1.
Joint Temperature: Joint temperatures are measured in degrees Celsius. Typical operating temperatures range from 20°C to 60°C. Temperatures above 60°C may indicate potential issues.
Vibration Level: Vibration levels are measured in units such as mm/s. Higher values may indicate wear or misalignment.
Position Error: Position error is measured in millimeters. Lower values indicate higher precision.
TCP Speed: TCP speed is measured in mm/s. Higher speeds may be required for certain applications but can affect precision.
Fault Prediction Score: The score ranges from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating a higher likelihood of an impending fault.
Remaining Useful Life (RUL): RUL is measured in hours and indicates the estimated time until the next maintenance is required.
Safety State: Possible states include 'Normal', 'Warning', and 'Emergency', indicating the current safety condition.
Emergency Stops: A higher number of emergency stops may indicate operational issues or safety concerns.
Tool Wear Percentage: Tool wear is expressed as a percentage, with 100% indicating the tool needs replacement.
Controller Load: Controller load is a measure of CPU or system load, typically ranging from 0 to 100%.

Weighted Fault Prediction Score (WFPS): For a given robot R, WFPS = \frac{\sum_{mf \in \text{maintenance_and_fault} \mid \text{upkeeprobot = R}} (faultpredscore \cdot w(mf))}{\sum_{mf \in \text{maintenance_and_fault} \mid \text{upkeeprobot = R}} w(mf)}, \text{where } w(mf) = 1 / (1 + \text{upkeepduedays})

Energy Efficiency Ratio (EER): For a given robot R, EER = \frac{\sum_{ps \in \text{performance_and_safety} \mid \text{effectivenessrobot = R}} energyusekwhval}{\text{TOH}}, \text{where TOH is used to normalize energy consumption.}

Joint Degradation Index (JDI): For a given robot R, JDI = \frac{\sum_{jc \in \text{joint_condition} \mid \text{jcdetref = R}} \sum_{i=1}^6 (jitempval_i / \text{MJT} + jivibval_i)}{\text{|}\{jc \in \text{joint_condition} \mid \text{jcdetref = R}\}| \cdot 6}, \text{where MJT normalizes temperatures, and jitempval_i, jivibval_i are joint i's temperature and vibration.}
Operation Cycle Efficiency (OCE): For a given robot R, OCE = \frac{\text{TPC}}{\sum_{o \in \text{operation} \mid \text{operbotdetref = R}} cycletimesecval}

Safety Incident Score (SIS): For a given robot R, SIS = \sum_{ps \in \text{performance_and_safety} \mid \text{effectivenessrobot = R}} (safety_metrics->>'overloads'::int + safety_metrics->>'collisions'::int + safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops'::int + safety_metrics->>'speed_violations'::int), \text{where JSONB fields are extracted and summed.}

Maintenance Cost Trend (MCT): For a given robot R, MCT = \frac{\sum_{mf \in \text{maintenance_and_fault} \mid \text{upkeeprobot = R}} \text{upkeepcostest} \cdot w(mf)}{\text{|}\{mf \in \text{maintenance_and_fault} \mid \text{upkeeprobot = R}\}|}, \text{where } w(mf) = \frac{1}{1 + \text{upkeepduedays}}

Controller Stress Index (CSI): For a given robot R, CSI = \frac{\sum_{sc \in \text{system_controller} \mid \text{systemoverseerrobot = R}} (controller_metrics->>'load_value'::float + controller_metrics->>'thermal_level'::float)}{\text{|}\{sc \in \text{system_controller} \mid \text{systemoverseerrobot = R}\}|}, \text{where JSONB fields load_value and thermal_level are averaged.}

Tool Wear Rate (TWR): For a given robot R, TWR = \frac{\sum_{ps \in \text{performance_and_safety} \mid \text{effectivenessrobot = R}} toolwearpct}{\text{TPC}}, \text{where TPC normalizes tool wear percentage.}

Joint Torque Variance (JTV): For a given robot R, JTV = \frac{\sum_{jp \in \text{joint_performance} \mid \text{jperfdetref = R}} \sum_{i=1}^6 ((joint_metrics->>'jointi'->>'torque'::float - \mu_i)^2)}{\text{|}\{jp \in \text{joint_performance} \mid \text{jperfdetref = R}\}| \cdot 6}, \text{where } \mu_i = \frac{\sum_{jp} joint_metrics->>'jointi'->>'torque'::float}{\text{|}\{jp\}|}, \text{and jointi is joint i's metrics.}

Payload Utilization Ratio (PUR): For a given robot R, PUR = \frac{\sum_{ad \in \text{actuation_data} \mid \text{actdetref = R}} payloadwval}{\text{(robot_details.payloadcapkg where botdetref = R)} \cdot \text{|}\{ad \in \text{actuation_data} \mid \text{actdetref = R}\}|}, \text{where RAY adjusts for age-related capacity changes if applicable.}

Maintenance Priority Level: For a robot R, the Maintenance Priority Level is:
- 'CRITICAL' if WFPS > 0.6 AND MRUL < 500
- 'WARNING' if WFPS > 0.4 OR MRUL < 500
- 'NORMAL' otherwise

Tool Replacement Status: For a robot R, the Tool Replacement Status is:
- 'URGENT' if TWR > 0.001 AND TPC > 10000
- 'WARNING' if TWR > 0.0005 OR average tool wear percentage > 75
- 'NORMAL' otherwise
Operational Instability: A robot R has Operational Instability if JTV > 50 and MJT > 60.

JDI-TOH Regression Slope: For a set of robots meeting JDI > 1.5, MJT > 65, and TOH > 5000, the JDI-TOH Regression Slope is given by \[ \text{slope} = \frac{n \sum (x_i y_i) - \sum x_i \sum y_i}{n \sum x_i^2 - (\sum x_i)^2} \] where \( y_i = \text{JDI} \) (Joint Degradation Index for robot \( i \)), \( x_i = \text{TOH} \) (Total Operating Hours for robot \( i \)), \( n \) is the number of qualifying robots, and sums are over all qualifying robots.

Average Cycle Time: For a given robot R, Average Cycle Time = \frac{\sum_{o \in \text{operation} \mid \text{operbotdetref = R}} \text{cycletimesecval}}{|\{o \in \text{operation} \mid \text{operbotdetref = R}\}|}
EER Rank: EER Rank = \text{PERCENT_RANK}() \text{ OVER } (\text{PARTITION BY } apptypeval \text{ ORDER BY } EER \text{ DESC})}
APE Rank: For a given robot R, APE Rank = \text{PERCENT_RANK}() \text{ OVER } (\text{PARTITION BY } ctrltypeval \text{ ORDER BY } APE \text{ DESC})

Program Efficiency Rank: For a program P, Program Efficiency Rank = \text{DENSE_RANK}() \text{ OVER } (\text{ORDER BY } \text{AVG(program_oce)} \text{ DESC}), \text{where program_oce is the Operation Cycle Efficiency for program P on each robot.}

Efficiency Metrics: For a model series, Efficiency Metrics = \text{jsonb_build_object}('most_efficient_program', \text{currprogval with Program Efficiency Rank = 1}, 'avg_program_efficiency', \text{AVG(avg_program_oce)}), \text{where avg_program_oce is the average Operation Cycle Efficiency per program.}
Robot Count: Let M be the model series, \mathcal{R}_M be the set of unique robot identifiers in M. Then Robot Count = |\mathcal{R}_M|

Model Average Position Error: Let M be the model series, \mathcal{R}_M be the set of unique robot identifiers in M. Then Model Avg Pos Error = \frac{\sum_{R \in \mathcal{R}_M} \text{APE}(R)}{|\mathcal{R}_M|}

Model Average TCP Speed: Let M be the model series, \mathcal{R}_M be the set of unique robot identifiers in M. Then Model Avg TCP Speed = \frac{\sum_{R \in \mathcal{R}_M} \text{ATCS}(R)}{|\mathcal{R}_M|}

Model Average Max Operating Hours: Let M be the model series, \mathcal{R}_M be the set of unique robot identifiers in M. Then Model Avg Max Ops Hours = \frac{\sum_{R \in \mathcal{R}_M} \text{TOH}(R)}{|\mathcal{R}_M|}
